legal.privacyReplayBody: Replay uses fixed example data. It sets no cookies and writes nothing to local storage, session storage, IndexedDB, or Cache Storage.
legal.privacyOwnerBody: When the owner signs in to provider settings, the app sets two Secure, SameSite Strict cookies for up to 15 minutes. The signed session cookie is HttpOnly. This page can read the CSRF cookie only when it protects a settings request.
legal.privacyKeyBody: The provider key is sent to the server, encrypted there, and never returned by the settings service. alphadecay does not save it in browser storage.
legal.privacyFlowBody: When the private agent runs, a limited evidence set is sent to the provider chosen by the owner. That provider handles the request under its own terms and privacy policy.
legal.privacyDraftBody: Text and .txt or .md files stay in memory while you edit. Choosing Review draft sends the fields to the alphadecay server. They are not saved in browser storage.
legal.privacyCurationBody: A later owner action sends the reviewed draft and named evidence to the configured AI provider.
legal.importantPaperBody: The connected build uses Alpaca's simulated trading environment. Replay has no account connection. Simulated fills can differ from live markets.
legal.importantAdviceBody: alphadecay is a hackathon prototype, not investment advice, a recommendation, or a brokerage service. Options can lose money, and no result promises future performance.
legal.importantModelBody: The selected model classifies the draft and named evidence into fixed fields. Application rules set the limits, choose the allowed decision, and stop when required information is missing.

protocolBuilder.scheduleIntro: Dates follow the market sequence. Times below are UTC and must use the signal date.
protocolBuilder.selectionIntro: Set absolute strike and expiry limits. The worksheet never guesses them from the current price.
protocolBuilder.qualityIntro: These limits decide when market data is too old, uneven, wide, or thin. Review them rather than accepting hidden defaults.
protocolBuilder.rulesIntro: Map each reviewed sentence to one observable comparison or fact. The source sentence remains unchanged.
